# Accessibility

A boundary someone needs to find a control or read its state meets 3:1 in every mode, drawn with a border or a surface color, never a shadow alone.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/ElevationAccessibility.mdx`

## Cards in forced colors

Forced colors drop background fills and shadows but keep borders. Every card carries a 1px transparent border, so its edge still shows there.
